infobox.usage: Unlocks Voron's hideout inside the hydroelectric power station on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Voron's hideout key (Voron) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key that opens the room located somewhere near the Health Resort. Belonged to one of the Arena gladiators by the name "Voron".

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text: - Can only be bartered from Ref LL3

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Voron's hideout inside the hydroelectric power station on Shoreline.
